title: ViCLEVR: A Visual Reasoning Dataset and Hybrid Multimodal Fusion Model for Visual Question Answering in Vietnamese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating an image-blind baseline model (LSTM-Q) that only takes the text of the questions as input (without seeing the images) to measure if the dataset contains linguistic shortcuts, allowing models to guess the correct answer using only language priors rather than true visual reasoning.

Introducing the ViCLEVR dataset and PhoViT multimodal model to evaluate visual reasoning capabilities specifically in Vietnamese, aiming to mitigate the resource disparity and English-centric focus prevalent in existing large-scale Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmarks.
